subject: Television & Streaming
title: Chinese Television and State Influence
description: A fast breakdown of Chinese Television and State Influence for builders.

hook.text: China has the world's largest TV audience, but its content is shaped by government censorship.

buildup.text: Historical dramas, romance, and fantasy thrive because they avoid sensitive modern topics.

discovery.text: Chinese streaming platforms like iQiyi and Youku rival Netflix in scale.

twist.text: Despite censorship, Chinese creators find ways to embed social commentary.

climax.text: Chinese television demonstrates that creativity adapts to constraints.

punchline.text: The world's biggest TV market tells stories around what it can't say.

quiz.question: How do Chinese television creators navigate government censorship?
options: They use metaphor, historical allegory, and indirect storytelling to embed social commentary
